.env.example.summary: Example environment variables for MySQL database/user credentials, root password, host-published MySQL port, and phpMyAdmin port.

compose.yaml.summary: Defines MySQL 8.4 and phpMyAdmin 5.2 services, loopback-only published ports, persistent mysql_data volume, SQL-based MySQL health check, and health-gated phpMyAdmin startup.

core/__init__.py.summary: Registers PyMySQL compatibility aliases for Django's MySQLdb-based database backend during core package initialization.

core/asgi.py.summary: ASGI deployment entry point; defaults DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE to core.settings and exposes the Django ASGI application.

core/settings.py.summary: Central Django configuration. Loads .env without overriding existing environment variables; configures local MySQL via django.db.backends.mysql and utf8mb4. Retains default contrib apps, middleware, templates, authentication validators, UTC timezone, and static settings. Development SECRET_KEY and DEBUG remain hardcoded.

core/urls.py.summary: Root URL configuration exposing only the built-in Django administration interface.

core/wsgi.py.summary: WSGI deployment entry point; defaults DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE to core.settings and exposes the Django WSGI application.

manage.py.summary: Django CLI entry point for development server, migrations, system checks, and other management commands; defaults to core.settings.

functions.name: main
functions.summary: Initializes the settings-module default and dispatches sys.argv to Django's management command runner.

requirements.txt.summary: Pinned Python dependencies: Django 6.1.3, asgiref 3.13.0, sqlparse 0.6.1, PyMySQL[rsa] 1.2.4, and python-dotenv 1.2.4.
